Text: Kuroro suddenly sends a communication saying he's encountered a dangerous individual... The previous crisis has been resolved, so there shouldn't be any danger left. But then, someone suddenly comes to mind. Someone who fought alongside you before—who Kuroro would in fact, consider dangerous. Though it's unlikely... it's better to take a look.
